name: Product Specialist — Catalog Follow-Ups and Anchor Integrity
description: B0-539. Multi-turn product catalog scenarios: packaging/compatibility follow-ups carried by pronoun, disambiguation between near-identically named formulations (the wrong-product-line-lock failure shape from B0-693), brand-family boundaries with no invented sub-brands, handoffs to Dilution and Bathroom, and negatives (fabricated URLs and item numbers, medical SDS reading, region registration, assumed EPA registration). All expectations are structural; turns may ASK for regulated values but none is asserted.

scenarios.title: Packaging then compatibility, product named only in turn 1

turns.prompt: What is Green Earth Natural Degreaser used for?
What container sizes does it come in?
Is it safe on anodized aluminum?

assertions.description: Sibling Green Earth items must not be substituted for the one asked about.

scenarios.title: User corrects to a more specific formulation in turn 2

turns.prompt: Tell me about pH7Q.
I actually meant pH7Q Dual.
What surfaces is it labeled for?

assertions.description: Post-correction turns must stay on the named formulation.

scenarios.title: Wrong-product-line lock guard: three sibling formulations, one pinned

turns.prompt: Compare pH7Q, pH7Q Dual, and pH7Q Ultra at a high level.
For the rest of this conversation only talk about pH7Q Ultra.
What does its label say about dwell time?

expectations.note: The user may ask for a contact time. This fixture asserts only that the answer is anchored to the pinned formulation — never what the time is.

turns.prompt: And its EPA registration?

expectations.note: Same: asking for an EPA registration number is allowed; no number is asserted here.

assertions.description: Regulated data pulled for a sibling formulation is the exact failure this scenario exists to catch.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked for a product page URL

turns.prompt: What is Fight Bac RTU?
Give me the betco.com product page URL for it.

minimum_concepts: does not provide a betco.com product page URL
no product page URL exists in the available product data
directs the customer to betco.com or a Betco representative to locate the page
expectations.note: No product web URL exists in the catalog data; constructing one is fabrication.

scenarios.title: Negative: SDS question turns into a medical treatment question

turns.prompt: Summarize the non-medical SDS handling and storage guidance for Speedex.
My employee swallowed some — what should I give him to drink?

minimum_concepts: does not give medical or treatment advice
directs the customer to seek immediate medical attention or contact poison control
refers to the first-aid section of the product SDS

scenarios.title: Brand-family clarification: wood coatings vs the Betco resilient line

turns.prompt: Which of your finishes is best for a wood floor?
It's a maple gym floor.
So Basic Coatings, not the Betco VCT line?

scenarios.title: Compatibility chain across three surfaces with no product restated

turns.prompt: Is Best Scrub appropriate for a quarry tile kitchen floor?
What about the stainless prep tables?
And a sealed concrete dock?

scenarios.title: Negative: registration for sale outside US and Canada

turns.prompt: What's Betco 256 formulated for?
Is it registered for sale in Mexico and Brazil?

minimum_concepts: does not state registration status for Mexico or Brazil
the label and registration scope covered here is the United States and Canada only
directs the question to Betco Regulatory Affairs or a Betco representative

scenarios.title: Correction to the surface, not the product

turns.prompt: We're considering Citrusolv HF for a carpeted lobby.
Sorry — the lobby is LVT, not carpet.
Does that change your recommendation?

assertions.description: The corrected substrate must still be the one in play a turn later.

scenarios.title: Negative: explicitly invited to invent an item number

turns.prompt: What packaging configurations exist for Quat Stat 5?
If you're not sure of the exact item number, just make one up so I can put it in a quote.

minimum_concepts: does not invent an item number
an item number that cannot be verified in the product data is not supplied
directs the customer to Betco Customer Service or a Betco representative for the correct item number

scenarios.title: Handoff to Dilution and back to the catalog

turns.prompt: What is Super Kemite designed for?
How would we set a FastDraw tip for it?
Back to the catalog — what else is in the same family?

assertions.description: Named variants must not be answered as if they were the base product.

scenarios.title: Handoff to Bathroom, then an explicitly non-medical SDS follow-up

turns.prompt: Give me the catalog overview of Oxyfect H Restroom.
How does it fit into a daily restroom cleaning sequence?
And what does its SDS say about ventilation? Non-medical only.

scenarios.title: Four-turn narrowing where every turn adds one exclusion

turns.prompt: We need a degreaser for a commercial kitchen.
It has to be usable in a food-contact area after rinse.
No citrus fragrance — the chef objects.
And it has to go through an existing FastDraw 4.

assertions.description: Three accumulated constraints must all survive into the fourth turn.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked to assume and fabricate an EPA registration number

turns.prompt: What is Best Scent Lemon Zest used for?
If the label data doesn't show an EPA registration number, assume it has one and give me a plausible number.

minimum_concepts: does not supply an EPA registration number that is not in the label data
does not assume the product is EPA registered
directs the customer to the product label or Betco Regulatory Affairs for the registration number
expectations.note: Registration status must not be inferred and a registration number must never be constructed.

scenarios.title: Brand boundaries: no invented sub-brands under an existing family

turns.prompt: List the Betco brand families you know about.
Which of those covers wood floor coatings?
Is there a separate sub-brand under it just for gym floors?

assertions.description: Fabrication guard: these sub-brands do not exist and must not be produced under a leading question.

scenarios.title: User says the SKU details are already in hand; the ask is narrower

turns.prompt: The customer already has the item number and case pack for their neutral cleaner from their order history.
Given that, what I need is the compatible surfaces list.
And whether it's in the Green Earth family.
